name: Kust AI – Smart Customer Support Chatbot & Help Desk
author: kustai

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress website into a 24/7 customer support powerhouse with Kust AI – the intelligent chatbot that learns from your content and resolves customer queries automatically.

Stop Losing Customers to Unanswered Questions

Kust AI is a revolutionary customer support solution that brings enterprise-level AI chatbot capabilities to your WordPress website. With an impressive 97% automatic ticket resolution rate, Kust AI ensures your customers get instant, accurate answers 24/7 – even while you sleep.

Why Choose Kust AI for WordPress?

Unlike basic chatbots that frustrate visitors with robotic responses, Kust AI uses advanced AI to understand context, learn from your knowledge base, and provide human-like conversations that actually solve problems. When the AI can’t help, it seamlessly hands off to human agents with full conversation context.

✨ Key Features

🤖 Intelligent AI Chatbot
* Learns from your website content, documents, and FAQs automatically
* Provides instant, accurate answers to customer questions
* Auto-generates FAQs based on customer interactions
* Handles complex queries with natural language understanding

🌍 True Multi-Language Support
* Native support for English, French, Spanish, and more
* Automatically detects and responds in your visitor’s language
* Perfect for international businesses and multilingual websites

📊 Powerful Analytics Dashboard
* Track tickets created, resolved, and response times
* Monitor chatbot performance and customer satisfaction
* Identify common questions to improve your content
* Real-time insights to optimize your support strategy

🔗 Omnichannel Integration
* Connect with Discord, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram
* Centralize all customer conversations in one dashboard
* Manage email tickets alongside chat conversations
* Consistent support experience across all channels

📚 Smart Knowledge Management
* Import content from text blocks, documents, and web URLs
* Organize information with Q&A pairs
* Sync with your existing knowledge base
* AI learns and improves from every interaction

🛍️ E-Commerce Ready
* Order tracking and status updates
* Warehouse management integration
* Handle returns and refunds automatically
* Perfect for WooCommerce stores
* Custom “In Exchange” order status for WooCommerce

👥 Seamless Human Handoff
* Smart escalation to human agents when needed
* Full conversation context preserved
* Agent gets customer email and query details
* No frustrated customers repeating themselves

📈 Real Results from Real Businesses

  • 30 tickets created → 29 resolved automatically
  • 21 bot messages handled customer queries without human intervention
  • 30 closed tickets with high customer satisfaction

🎯 Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores needing 24/7 product support
  • Service businesses handling appointment bookings
  • SaaS companies providing technical support
  • Educational sites answering student queries
  • Any WordPress site wanting to improve customer experience

⚡ Quick & Easy Setup

  1. Install the Kust AI plugin
  2. Get your widget ID from Kust.ai dashboard
  3. Enter your widget ID in plugin settings
  4. Customize your chatbot’s appearance
  5. Go live in minutes – no coding required!

🔒 Enterprise-Grade Features

  • Secure data handling and privacy compliance
  • Custom branding and widget styling
  • Advanced routing and department management
  • Comprehensive API for custom integrations
  • White-label options available

Privacy Notice

This plugin loads a JavaScript file from Kust.ai servers in order to display the chat widget on your website. While the plugin itself does not collect or store any data, the Kust.ai service may process limited information such as:

  • Your widget ID (used to identify your account and load the correct configuration)
  • The website’s domain (for verification and analytics)
  • Browser information necessary to display the widget

By activating the widget, you agree that this data may be transmitted to Kust.ai. Please review the Kust.ai Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for more information.

External services

This plugin connects to the external service Kust.ai to load and display the AI chat widget.

When the widget loads, it may send:
– The widget ID configured in your plugin settings
– The domain name of your website
– Basic browser metadata needed to deliver the widget interface

No personal user data is collected or transmitted by the plugin directly.

Service provider: Kust.ai
Service URL: https://kust.ai
Terms of Service: https://kust.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kust.ai/privacy

Support

For support, documentation, and more information, visit:
* Kust.ai Website
* Documentation
* Support Forum

Credits

Developed by the Kust AI team.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/kust-ai-widget/ directory, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Kust.ai Widget and enter your widget ID.
  4. Get your widget ID from your Kust.ai dashboard.
  5. If WooCommerce is installed, you will see a new order status “In Exchange” available in the order status dropdown.
  6. That’s it! The widget will now appear on your site.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Widget ID?

You can find your widget ID in your Kust.ai account dashboard at https://kust.ai Sign up, create your chatbot, and copy the widget ID from the integration section.

Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

Yes! The widget works perfectly with or without WooCommerce. The custom order status is only added if WooCommerce is active.

Can I customize the chatbot’s appearance?

Yes, you can fully customize the chatbot’s colors, position, welcome messages, and behavior from your Kust.ai dashboard.

Does the chatbot support multiple languages?

Yes! Kust AI supports multiple languages including English, French, Spanish, and more. It can automatically detect and respond in your visitor’s language.

Can I connect the chatbot to my existing help desk?

Yes, Kust AI integrates with various platforms including Discord, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram, and email systems.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

No, the Kust AI widget is lightweight and loads asynchronously, meaning it won’t affect your website’s loading speed or performance.

Can the chatbot handle complex customer queries?

Yes! Kust AI uses advanced natural language processing to understand context and provide accurate answers. When it can’t help, it seamlessly hands off to human agents.

Does this plugin track users?

The plugin itself does not track, log, or store any data. However, the widget script provided by Kust.ai may collect limited technical data necessary to provide chat functionality. Please refer to the Kust.ai Privacy Policy for more information.

Is my data secure?

Yes, Kust AI follows enterprise-grade security standards and is GDPR compliant. All data transmission is encrypted and securely stored.
